publisher: Pew Research Center's Internet Project and Elon University's Imagining the Internet Center
series: Digital Life in 2025 (Future of the Internet VI)

entries.label: Major cyber attack causes widespread harm
entries.quote: By 2025, will a major cyber attack have caused widespread harm to a nation's security and capacity to defend itself and its people? (By "widespread harm," we mean significant loss of life or property losses/damage/theft at the levels of tens of billions of dollars.)
entries.subject: major cyber attack

notes: One yes/no question from the Future of the Internet VI canvassing (eight questions, published as separate 2014 reports). share_agree is the share answering 'yes', share_disagree the share answering 'no'. Respondents were asked to elaborate; the reports say some answers were hopes, not predictions. Non-random opt-in canvassing. Also published 2014-10-09: 'Killer Apps in the Gigabit Age', a yes/no question on new bandwidth-driven killer apps in the US by 2025; the report prints no yes/no shares, so it is not captured.
